I learn best when I have to explain something to someone else. This blog is where I do that in public.

## How a post gets made

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Something I learned or built] --> B[Draft with a diagram first]
  B --> C[Preview on my machine]
  C --> D[Publish]
```

## What I plan to write about

- Scientific machine learning, starting from the basics.
- Computational fluid dynamics and where ML helps (and where it does not).
- Lessons from the tools I am building.
